cases.name: Essie Victoria Benekin Guest
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Victoria was a lifelong member of Messiah Reformed Episcopal Church where she served faithfully until death. She served in the following capacities:  Senior Missionary Society, Senior Choir, Sunday School Teacher, Class Leader, and the Vestry Board. She was the President of Messiah’s Women of the Church.

She was also very active in the Diocese of the Southeast of the Reformed Episcopal Church where she served as Upper Berkeley Convocation Chairperson for the Missionary Convention for several years.

She was faithful in her community and served as President of the Pineville-Eadytown Committee and was also a member of the Community Prayer Band. Victoria was a longtime Manager/Member of the United Gospel Singers of Pineville, SC.

Victoria was a woman who loved the Lord, and she showed it through her worship, ministry of singing, and her daily life living. She never met a stranger that she did not welcome into her home. Her love for people was sweet and genuine, she would do anything for anyone. There was always room at her table, she loved to cook, and oh could she cook!

She was affectionately known to all as ‘Ms. Victoria’ and was considered a mother, grandmother, and auntie to all who knew her. Her two grandsons, Tyler and Titus, were her heart.

Victoria graduated from Russellville High School in 1955. She was employed with Charleston Manufacturing and Berkeley Manufacturing and later, Berkeley County School District.

In July 1955, she was united in Holy Matrimony to Zack “Zackie” Benekin and to this union, one child was born Lutrica “Caritha” Gethers. In November 2020, she married her longtime friend St. Julian Guest. They both preceded her in death."
